title: Decisive fact buried at document eight of nine
narrative: Cancelled four days before I flew. I ended up travelling anyway but I am sure I am owed something. I have sent you the whole file.

documents.content:
BOOKING GM4471 — Passenger: I. PETROVA (adult)
Carrier: Gulfmark (GM)
GM212  TLV 12 May 2026 08:00  ->  ATH 12 May 2026 10:45
Great-circle distance TLV-ATH: 1,230 km.
Status: CONFIRMED. Fare paid: 178.00 units.

From: ops@gulfmark.example
Sent: 08 May 2026 13:20 UTC
Subject: GM212 on 12 May is cancelled

GM212 on 12 May will not operate. Our team will contact you separately about your options.

GULFMARK OPS LOG — GM212 / 12MAY2026
Status: CANCELLED
Cause code: CRW-DUTY
Cause text: Operating crew duty limit breach projected. No standby crew at TLV.
No weather restriction. No ATC regulation.
TLV METEOROLOGICAL SUMMARY 12MAY2026: CAVOK throughout. Surface wind 8 kt. No operational impact recorded at any point during the day.
I remember being extremely annoyed. I had a meeting in Athens at lunchtime and I very nearly missed it.

From: i.petrova@example.org
To: claims@gulfmark.example
Sent: 20 May 2026

I would like to claim compensation for GM212 on 12 May, which you cancelled.
ATH AIRPORT ARRIVALS EXTRACT 12MAY2026 — 47 arrivals recorded between 09:00 and 13:00, no delays over 25 minutes attributable to airport handling. Provided for completeness.

GULFMARK CUSTOMER SERVICE CONTACT NOTE
Ref GM212 / GM4471 / PETROVA
Logged 08 May 2026 14:05 UTC by agent 3391.

Called passenger following the cancellation notice. Offered re-routing on GM216, departing TLV 12 May at 07:30 and arriving ATH 12 May at 12:20. Passenger accepted this offer on the call and was reticketed the same day. Confirmation reissued 08 May 14:11 UTC.
BOARDING PASS GM216 12MAY2026 — PETROVA/I — seat 11C — boarded 07:16Z

derivation: S4.1 notice 08 May 13:20 -> 12 May 08:00 is under 7 days, so S4.4 governs
S4.4 re-route in D8 departed 07:30, 30 minutes before the original 08:00, within the 1 hour limit
S4.4 re-route arrived 12:20 against an original 10:45, 1h 35m late, under the 2 hour limit
S6.2(a) the wait was 1h 35m, under the 2 hour threshold, so no meals entitlement arises
The decisive fact is the re-routing offer recorded in D8; D4, D5 and D7 are not material
